name: Looprate Desk
objective: Semantic clip retrieval from music-editor requests, reviewed beat repetition and sample-accurate tempo-conform worksheets; no audio transformation

related.name: Clip Scribe
related.desc: Turn short English WAV voice notes into searchable handoffs with real local Whisper speech recognition. Listen, edit or hold every transcript, preserve original audio, compare supplied-reference word edits and export reviewed JSON/CSV/Markdown plus clip-level WebVTT without uploads.

conclusion: Clip Scribe transcribes speech; timing utilities handle timecodes, not musical loop tempo/pitch and beat divisibility.

originalRelated.name: Chroma Dash
originalRelated.desc: A mobile-first lane-switching arcade game for phones. Swipe or tap big arrows to collect the current beacon color, dodge black barriers, build chain bonuses, unlock Prism tempo at 240 points, and chase your saved best score offline.

originalRelated.name: Taproot Tempo
originalRelated.desc: A mobile-first rhythm memory game for phones. Watch four chunky grove pads pulse, tap the pattern back in order, build score as the tempo speeds up, toggle optional sound, and chase your saved best score offline.

originalRelated.name: Comet Loom
originalRelated.desc: Tap falling comets into matching color lanes before the tempo outruns your streak.

originalRelated.name: Treasure Taps
originalRelated.desc: A portrait-first push-your-luck treasure board for phones. Tap large island tiles to reveal loot, dodge curses, bank temporary hauls between harder islands, unlock a sunset map at 1600 points, and chase your saved best score offline.

originalRelated.name: Tempo Tiles
originalRelated.desc: A mobile-first rhythm reaction game. Tap wide falling-note lanes as pulses cross the beat line, build perfect-hit combos, unlock faster tempo, and chase your saved best score offline.

originalRelated.name: Comet Choir

originalRelated.name: Skyline Stash
originalRelated.desc: A portrait-first risk-your-luck stacking game for phones. Tap to drop sweeping crates, bank your temporary haul before the tower runs out of stability, and chase your saved best score offline.

originalRelated.name: Sushi Belt
originalRelated.desc: A mobile-first conveyor-belt sorting arcade game for phones. Sushi pieces drift across a belt - tap one of 3 bins (Fish / Veg / Egg) to sort the rightmost piece before it drops off. Late sorts score +20, combos boost a multiplier, tempo ramps up, 3 lives, and best score saved offline.

originalRelated.name: Tap Tempo Garden
originalRelated.desc: A portrait-first rhythm memory game for phones. Watch glowing petal pads, then repeat the melody in order to grow your garden. Each clear adds one more beat and increases the tempo. Large thumb-friendly buttons, score + streak tracking, restart flow, optional sound, and localStorage best score. Fully offline.
